summary: This Form 6-K by Galiano Gold Inc. (foreign private issuer) is a routine interim-report filing, submitting unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A, CEO and CFO certifications, and a related news release, all for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. It contains no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review. It briefly reflects balance-sheet changes (restricted cash, non-controlling interest) but no announced deal, recommendation, or structural event. As a standard periodic current report, it does not qualify as a special situation, so the correct classification is None.
